name: Dr. Scent Smart Aroma Tower Pro
tagline: Bluetooth-controlled architectural scenting for residences & upscale retail - Updated
shortDescription: Standing column diffuser with integrated smartphone Bluetooth scheduling. Perfect for living rooms, hotel suites, and boutique showrooms.
description: A statement piece in modern interior architecture. The Smart Aroma Tower Pro delivers continuous, finely calibrated fragrance dispersal across spacious open-plan homes and retail settings. Set individual operating schedules, work hours, and scent intensities per day of the week via the companion iOS and Android app.

features: Bluetooth 5.0 smart scheduling app

name: Dr. Scent HVAC Central Scent System 5000
tagline: Commercial AHU/HVAC duct-integrated scent architecture for large venues
shortDescription: Direct HVAC ductwork integration unit. Delivers completely invisible, uniform scent distribution across entire hotel lobbies, conference centres, and flagship retail.
description: Designed specifically for mechanical contractors, facility directors, and luxury hoteliers. The HVAC 5000 connects directly into central air handling units (AHU) or duct systems. Utilizing advanced dual-fluid sub-micron atomization, the fragrance molecules stay suspended in airflow without adhering to duct walls or filters.
usageInstructions: Professional mounting to wall or direct duct connection bracket.
Install the high-pressure PTFE tube into the supply air plenum.
Insert 500ml or 1,000ml Dr. Scent commercial fragrance bottle.
Configure operating calendar through onboard LCD or remote Wi-Fi module.
features: Seamless integration with building management systems (BMS)
Continuous airflow sensing prevents dispersal when ventilation is inactive
Massive 5,000 sq.ft coverage capacity from a single discrete unit
Industrial-grade twin diaphragm pump with 10,000h lifespan rating
Compliant with international building air safety guidelines

specifications.value: Standard HVAC duct probe tube included
